create_temporarily_pop_interpreter_stack: create a context manager that temporarily pops and restores the functorch interpreter stack
create_nested_contexts: create a context manager that nests multiple context managers together using ExitStack
retrieve_current_functorch_interpreter: retrieve the current functorch interpreter from the interpreter stack and coerce it to the appropriate subclass
dispatch_functorch: dispatch a functorch operation by retrieving the current interpreter and processing it with unwrapped arguments
coerce_cinterpreter: coerce a C++ CInterpreter object into the appropriate Python interpreter subclass based on its transform type
